beat_player.text: ok {player} took the field lmao. entry 483 in the ledger, dont get comfy :)
fine u won this round. ur name is underlined twice in the ledger now. rematch when u have dry boots
Hold still while I count the cost. Those {troop_count} men of mine will be written down for the lore. You owe me a rematch, and I will collect it.
Well played, I suppose. Your banners look nice, shame about the swords. I'll be back for the {gold} you took today, mark my words.

fleeing already {player}? i was hoping for a proper fight. rude. ledger notes ur cowardice in bold
{player} saw my banners and bolted. smart, but the roads get long and i can wait :)
ran off {player}? ill chase u one day, it will be fun i promise. im kidding... mostly

heard {rival} called me a bot. tell them ill be at their farm next week, bring the torches xD

hey {player} u up? {town} road, sundown. loser buys the ale. or i burn ur wagon, same thing :)

encounter_threatened.text: Pay {gold}? Ha! I will pay you in arrows, {player}. Keep talking. Every word goes in the ledger for later.
You are asking for {gold} with a straight face? Bold. I will think about it while I set fire to your lovely cart.
Okay {player}, that is a lot of gold for a bit of walking. Let's talk first. I will still tease you about it, obviously.
{player} you are threatening me? Cute. I will give you {gold} once you learn to spell the word surrender :)

encounter_greeting.text: Oh look, it's {player}. Still owe me a farm, I remember. This is {persona} of {my_faction}, and I am about to make the ledger cry.
{player}! {persona} of {my_faction} here. I have been keeping score of every insult you ever typed, so you are in for a long chat.
{player}, it is {persona} from {my_faction}. Honestly you are my favourite person to burn things in front of. No hard feelings, only ash.

ambient_brag.text: just counted {troop_count} lads and {gold} gold in {fief}. the ledger is thick and the farms are ash, life is good xD
{fief} is mine now. i had {troop_count} bodies and a torch. nobody asked but im telling u anyway lol
{gold} gold and still nobody has beaten me in {fief} twice. thats a record. go ahead and seethe :)
burned the mill in {fief} and took {gold} from the chest. honest work, honest fire

heard u lost {troop_count} to some dude in a ditch {player}. i dont care. ok i care a little, sorry for the laugh xD
{player} got wrecked, {troop_count} gone. rough. ill wait till they rebuild so i can wreck them again
{player} that was rough, {troop_count} is a lot to lose. u ok? also still mine to beat later, dont forget that

anyone else smell smoke from {village}? nah thats just me, the mill is a happy memory xD
